python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QImage, QPainter, QPixmap
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.ImageViewer(%PARENT%)
img = QImage(220, 128, QImage.Format.Format_ARGB32)
img.fill(QColor("#1e3a5f"))
p = QPainter(img)
p.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
p.setBrush(QColor("#38bdf8"))
p.drawRoundedRect(24, 24, 84, 80, 12, 12)
p.setBrush(QColor("#f59e0b"))
p.drawEllipse(128, 30, 68, 68)
p.end()
control.setPixmap(QPixmap.fromImage(img))

effectHint.en: Manual preserves the current scale; adjust Zoom factor to change it.
effectHint.zh: 手动模式沿用当前缩放；调整缩放比例可查看变化。

effectHint.en: Changing the zoom selects Manual mode. Automatic fit modes compute the zoom from available space.
effectHint.zh: 调整倍率会切换到手动模式；自动适应模式根据可用空间计算倍率。

effectHint.en: Applies to a discrete mouse wheel. Touchpad scrolling pans; Ctrl/Command + scroll zooms.
effectHint.zh: 控制离散鼠标滚轮；触控板滚动用于平移，按住 Ctrl/⌘ 滚动可缩放。

effectHint.en: Auto shows the toolbar on hover or focus; move the pointer and focus away to compare it with Always.
effectHint.zh: 自动模式在悬停或聚焦时显示工具栏；移开鼠标并移走焦点可查看与常显模式的区别。

effectHint.en: Shows a transient indicator during zoom input when the toolbar is hidden.
effectHint.zh: 工具栏隐藏时，在缩放交互中短暂显示比例提示。
